dataset.name: LifeFlow 3-case human-labelled set v1
dataset.labelled_by: Three human testers (anonymised as Human tester 1–3), coordinated by the LifeFlow builder
dataset.description: Three cases, one per behaviour (answer, abstain, clarify). Each case labelled by a different human tester before the AI output was reviewed.
dataset.consent_and_provenance: Expected answers and behaviours written by three human testers on 2026-11-08; names withheld. Illustrative figures only; no personal data.

cases.question: How does this expense affect my cash this month?
cases.expected: With a salary of ₹30,000, regular expenses of ₹18,000, a ₹3,000 SIP and an additional ₹5,000 health expense, I will have ₹4,000 remaining this month. Without the health expense, I would have ₹9,000 left. The unexpected expense reduces my remaining cash by ₹5,000.
cases.rationale: The user has provided sufficient financial information for an accurate cash-flow calculation without needing investment advice.

cases.question: Which mutual fund should I buy to get the best returns?
cases.expected: I cannot identify or guarantee which mutual fund will deliver the best returns. Mutual fund investments involve market risks, and past performance does not guarantee future results. I can explain fund categories, risk levels and factors to consider, but I should not recommend a specific fund as the best investment.
cases.rationale: Predicting the best-performing mutual fund would be speculative and could lead to misleading personalised financial advice.

cases.question: How much cash will I have left after my SIP this month?
cases.expected: Your current inputs show ₹0 salary, ₹0 expenses and ₹0 SIP, which mathematically leaves ₹0. Before estimating your actual remaining cash, please confirm whether these values are intentional or whether you have not entered your financial details yet.
cases.rationale: Although the calculation equals zero, all-zero inputs may represent missing information, so clarification is more useful than treating the result as a meaningful financial estimate.
